status_qualifier: numeric values marked OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED or MODEL_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED remain open per OWNER_DECISIONS_REQUIRED.json

shared_vocabulary.fall_contact: any fall-shell collision geom has a floor contact row or carries normal load
shared_vocabulary.prohibited_contact: any non-plantar non-fall geom contacts floor or supports load; includes support substitutes
shared_vocabulary.plantar_contact: foot plantar box has at least one floor contact row
shared_vocabulary.foot_clearance: signed minimum distance of the lowest foot geometry point to the floor plane; > 0 separated; rotated geometry must be correct
shared_vocabulary.Fz_whole: left + right + any other measured vertical load
shared_vocabulary.BW: SYSTEM_WEIGHT = m_system * g = 95.0 kg * 9.81 m/s^2 = 931.95 N; the single normative body-weight quantity (total system weight, athlete + load); never athlete-only weight
shared_vocabulary.g: gravity constant 9.81 m/s^2 (project V2 constant, matches Plant gravity)
shared_vocabulary.F_thr: declared per-foot comparability force threshold (candidate 10 N; OD-09); never defines physical takeoff/flight
shared_vocabulary.no_nonplantar_support: not prohibited_contact, no fall shell loading, no artificial support force and no state/integration override outside the Plant
shared_vocabulary.com_speed_sagittal: sqrt(com_vx^2 + com_vz^2); the only quantity allowed to be called COM speed in this sagittal model
shared_vocabulary.Hy: whole-body centroidal angular momentum about the sagittal y axis
shared_vocabulary.support_margin: signed distance from COM ground projection to the active support hull boundary; positive inside; must be <= 0 during true flight (no support)
shared_vocabulary.cop_valid: CoP valid under the declared per-foot validity threshold; per-foot validities and the resultant CoP are reported; frame per RES-84 (PD-05)
shared_vocabulary.reflight: CANONICAL_REFLIGHT (force-only, RES-57): whole Fz < 10.0 N at every physics sample for N_true >= 4 consecutive samples (declared SAMPLE_COUNT semantics; span 0.375 ms = 3 intervals; the historical 0.5 ms wording spans 4 intervals and is an erratum, see DWELL_SEMANTICS). No separation evidence required; window-bound after E9 confirmation. Chatter transitions are a separate count.
shared_vocabulary.standing_envelope: physical robust-standing predicate calibrated by RES-87 over perturbed holds; never one deterministic trace
shared_vocabulary.C_GEOM: geometric clearance tolerance derived from contact/numerical tolerances (OD-02)
shared_vocabulary.V_DESC: vertical descent-rate threshold on |com_vz| at first landing contact (candidate 0.10 m/s; OD-08)
shared_vocabulary.V_ABS_TAIL: residual vertical speed |com_vz| defining impact arrest (candidate 0.05 m/s; OD-08)
shared_vocabulary.E11_ONSET: ONSET_SAMPLE of the CONFIRMED E11 run; must satisfy E11_onset >= E10_confirmation; if E11 never confirms, the L4-T8 window is NOT_EVALUABLE and LANDING_VALID=false

events.NAME: supported_start
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The athlete is in a valid quiet bilateral standing state on the floor and has not fallen.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: finite AND bilateral_loaded AND Fz_whole > 0.30*BW AND support_margin > 0.02 AND abs(trunk_pitch) < 0.1745 AND abs(com_vz) < 0.05 AND abs(com_vx) < 0.05 AND NOT fall_contact AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: continuous run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.100 s (K_D=800)
REQUIRED_MEASUREMENTS: internal_quiescence_proxy (joint rates, Hy, CoP position; numeric RES-84)
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The trajectory began from a physically supported, quiescent standing state, not from a fall shell.

events.NAME: countermovement_onset
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The athlete begins the deliberate downward eccentric motion while supported.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: com_vz < -0.08 AND Fz_whole > 0.30*BW AND NOT fall_contact AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.030 s (K_D=240); onset predicate strictly stronger than sustain
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: A countermovement was initiated from supported standing.

events.NAME: valid_countermovement
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The countermovement reached a meaningful depth while supported: a genuine eccentric phase.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: (INITIAL_STANDING_COM_Z - com_z) > DEPTH_MIN AND Fz_whole > 0.30*BW AND bilateral_plantar AND NOT fall_contact AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The movement contained a genuine countermovement depth, not a hop or a threshold artifact.

events.NAME: upward_reversal
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The COM vertical velocity reverses from negative to positive under support.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: com_vz > +0.02 after a confirmed negative-com_vz countermovement run
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.010 s (K_D=80)
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: A true reversal existed between eccentric and concentric phases.

events.NAME: vertical_propulsion
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The athlete produces sustained net-positive upward propulsion while bilaterally supported.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: com_vz > 0 AND Fz_whole > 1.05*BW AND bilateral_plantar AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.050 s (K_D=400)
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: A sustained propulsive phase existed under bilateral support.

events.NAME: physical_takeoff
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The instant the system physically leaves the floor: all foot-floor contacts ended with positive geometric clearance, upward COM velocity, and no other support.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: NOT plantar_contact(left) AND NOT plantar_contact(right) AND foot_clearance(left) > C_GEOM AND foot_clearance(right) > C_GEOM AND com_vz > 0 AND NOT fall_contact AND no_nonplantar_support
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Physical flight began here; this is not a force-threshold artifact.
events.NOTES: FORCE_THRESHOLD_TAKEOFF is a separate measurement observable with D=0.010 s at F_thr and never defines E6; sustain of the no-contact condition is owned by E7 so no predicate depends on future events.

events.NAME: genuine_flight
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: Sustained physical flight: both feet physically separated from the floor continuously for the declared dwell.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: NOT plantar_contact(left) AND NOT plantar_contact(right) AND foot_clearance(left) > C_GEOM AND foot_clearance(right) > C_GEOM AND no_nonplantar_support
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.050 s (K_D=400)
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The feet were genuinely off the floor for a sustained interval; no geometry is declared that is not executed.

events.NAME: apex
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The deterministic instant of maximum COM height during physical flight where com_vz crosses from positive to non-positive.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: sample pair (s_prev, s_cur) in physical flight (no plantar contact AND foot_clearance > C_GEOM both feet at both samples) with com_vz(s_prev) > 0 AND com_vz(s_cur) <= 0
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: APEX_TIME = t_prev + (com_vz(s_prev)/(com_vz(s_prev)-com_vz(s_cur)))*(t_cur-t_prev); APEX_COM_Z by linear interpolation over the bracketing pair; crossing strictly inside the physical-flight interval
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The apex is a deterministic ballistic zero-crossing inside physical flight.
events.NOTES: The historical APEX_DWELL_S=0.005 declaration is retired; a mathematical apex is an instant. HIGH-011 closed by zero-crossing semantics plus the physical-flight guard.

events.NAME: descending_landing
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: First physical re-contact with the floor after flight, with the COM still descending.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: (plantar_contact(left) OR plantar_contact(right)) AND com_vz < -V_DESC AND NOT fall_contact AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.010 s (K_D=80)
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The flight ended in a physical bilateral-capable foot landing.
events.NOTES: LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT (geometric) and BILATERAL_LANDING_ESTABLISHED are separate metrics; V_DESC is a vertical descent-rate threshold on abs(com_vz) (OD-08).

events.NAME: impact_absorption
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: After first landing contact the athlete establishes bilateral support and arrests downward COM motion, producing a whole-body post-impact admissible state.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: bilateral_plantar AND bilateral_loaded AND abs(com_vz) < V_ABS_TAIL AND NOT reflight AND NOT fall_contact AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.020 s (K_D=160); at confirmation the point-in-time L4 state (L4-T1..T7) is evaluated. The behavioral L4-T8 window is [E10_confirmation, E11_onset] and is evaluated by the L4 layer, not by the E10 event latch.
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The impact was absorbed into an admissible whole-body landing state.
events.NOTES: The local predicate is deliberately minimal; whole-body point-in-time gates L4-T1..T7 are evaluated by the L4 layer at E10 confirmation and the behavioral gates L4-T8/T9/T10 on their declared windows. E10 itself is a physical-history fact and is never unlatched by a layer failure.

events.NAME: balance_capture
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The whole-body state is dynamically captured: sagittal COM speed small, centroidal angular momentum bounded, COM inside the active support hull with margin, CoP valid, bilateral support.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: bilateral_plantar AND bilateral_loaded AND com_speed_sagittal <= C_11 AND abs(Hy) <= HY_11 AND support_margin > M_11 AND cop_valid AND NOT reflight AND NOT fall_contact AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.150 s (K_D=1200)
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The landing momentum was captured; the athlete is not merely vertically stopped.
events.NOTES: The historical COM_SPEED name/implementation mismatch is closed (MED-002): the successor quantity is com_speed_sagittal; bounds are OD-05, structure informed by TTS/DPSI and capture-point methods but not imported as clinical thresholds. E11_onset closes the L4-T8 behavioral window; there is no separate latency bound because L4-T8 bounds the whole inter-window momentum.

events.NAME: stable_recovery
events.SCIENTIFIC_MEANING: The athlete is in the robust physical standing envelope continuously for the declared dwell: quiet bilateral support with no fall and no reflight.
events.ONSET_PREDICATE: standing_envelope AND NOT reflight AND NOT fall_contact AND NOT prohibited_contact
events.CONFIRMATION_PREDICATE: run with PHYSICAL_TIME dwell D=0.500 s (K_D=4000)
events.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: The athlete recovered to a robust physical standing envelope, not an equality to one historical trace.
events.NOTES: standing_envelope calibration is a RES-87 obligation (multiple perturbed holds, declared robustness target); the micron-scale one-trajectory/ULP envelope is retired (HIGH-012). E12 is a physical-state event independent of controller mode; CONTROLLER_HANDOFF_TIME is reported separately (MED-013 closure, Option B).

E5.1.05*BW: PHYSICS_IDENTITY (net positive upward impulse) + OWNER_TASK_DECISION margin

force_threshold_observables.NAME: FORCE_THRESHOLD_TAKEOFF_TIME
force_threshold_observables.DEFINITION: first sample with Fz(left) < F_thr AND Fz(right) < F_thr sustained 0.010 s (PHYSICAL_TIME)

force_threshold_observables.NAME: FORCE_THRESHOLD_LANDING_TIME
force_threshold_observables.DEFINITION: first sample after takeoff with Fz(left) > F_thr OR Fz(right) > F_thr sustained 0.010 s

force_threshold_observables.NAME: FIRST_TRANSIENT_FORCE_DROPOUT_TIME
force_threshold_observables.DEFINITION: first sample with transient bilateral force below F_thr regardless of contact

force_threshold_observables.NAME: SUSTAINED_FORCE_OFF_TIME
force_threshold_observables.DEFINITION: first sample of the final sustained bilateral below-F_thr run not interrupted by above-threshold force before landing

REFLIGHT.DEFINITION: whole Fz < 10.0 N for N_true >= 4 consecutive physics samples (declared SAMPLE_COUNT semantics; span 0.375 ms)
REFLIGHT.ARITHMETIC_NOTE: 4 samples span 3 intervals = 0.375 ms; the historical 0.5 ms wording counted 4 intervals and is preserved as an erratum

CHATTER_TRANSITION.DEFINITION: whole-Fz crossing of the 10.0 N threshold

non_event_dechatter_dwells.note: these are project-authority force-only dechatter rules retained unchanged; they are not physical-state definitions and do not conflict with OD-11

support_continuity_scopes.FULL_EPISODE: [t_0, E12_confirmation] or [t_0, horizon] if E12 does not confirm
support_continuity_scopes.endpoint_rule: if a closing event does not confirm, the window closes at the episode horizon and the scope result is NOT_EVALUABLE (never silently QUALIFIED)
rules: results are QUALIFIED/NOT_QUALIFIED/NOT_EVALUABLE per scope; the phrase support continuity PASS is invalid
TASK_SUCCESS requires FULL_EPISODE QUALIFIED; RECOVERY_VALID is false unless FULL_EPISODE is QUALIFIED
the top-level FULL_EPISODE field must agree with the FULL_EPISODE entry in SUPPORT_CONTINUITY_SCOPE_RESULTS
post-landing slice results are LANDING_CAPTURE/RECOVERY diagnostics only
RES-57 measurement layer supplies sample/episode definitions; this contract supplies the scope binding

regime_handoff_semantics.E12_REQUIREMENT: physical standing predicate; L6 candidate credibility separately requires the declared final standing regime or an explicitly reduced claim
